commands.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
$jarPath=(Resolve-Path 'build/libs/simplerail-1.0.0.jar').Path
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $jarPath -Destination docs/evidence/T-005/simplerail-1.0.0.jar
$zip=[System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($jarPath)
try {
 $entries=@($zip.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })
 $entry=$zip.GetEntry('META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml')
 if ($null -eq $entry) { throw 'Missing mod metadata' }
 $reader=New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($entry.Open())
 try { $metadata=$reader.ReadToEnd() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
 $metadata | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 docs/evidence/T-005/neoforge.mods.toml.txt
 $entries | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 docs/evidence/T-005/jar-entries.txt
 $class=$zip.GetEntry('com/ericchiu/simplerail/SimpleRail.class'); $stream=$class.Open(); $bytes=New-Object byte[] 8
 try { $null=$stream.Read($bytes,0,8) } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
 $classMajor=([int]$bytes[6])*256+[int]$bytes[7]
 [ordered]@{jar=$jarPath;evidenceJar='docs/evidence/T-005/simplerail-1.0.0.jar';sha256=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $jarPath).Hash;bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $jarPath).Length;classMajor=$classMajor;entryCount=$entries.Count;metadata=$metadata} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 docs/evidence/T-005/artifact.json
} finally { $zip.Dispose() }
Copy-Item build/tmp/createMinecraftArtifacts/nfrt_artifact_manifest.properties docs/evidence/T-005/resolved-artifact-manifest.properties
Get-Content -Encoding UTF8 docs/evidence/T-005/build-attempt-02.json,docs/evidence/T-005/artifact.json
Select-String -Path docs/evidence/T-005/resolved-artifact-manifest.properties -Pattern 'neoforge|parchment|neoform' | Select-Object -First 12

# The name of the mod loader type to load - for regular FML @Mod mods it should be javafml
